findings.boundary: Unknown repair status and normal reads
findings.observation: The normal read gate blocks only status prepared. The repair entry rejects unknown status, but an unknown/missing status can remove read exclusion before a transaction is actually applied.
findings.counterexample: Fault after complete output audit before version increment, change transition status to unknown, then call fresh-instance freeze/list/load. All must reject instead of exposing next-version definitions at input registry version.
findings.suggestion: For repair-schema/mode transitions, block ordinary reads unless status is a recognized valid terminal applied; retain appropriate legacy compatibility.

scope_limits: Read-only static inspection only. No driver, staging, admission, transaction, fault or publication has been invoked. Findings require actual entry verification after the parent preparation driver is ready.
